purpose: Teach: 杉山/土井/松尾/大石/杉浦/小坂/田原/赤松

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「杉山おじさんは絵が上手」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying how Sugiyama is really good at drawing.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic tone. Sharing something she heard quietly. Gentle rhythm, as if remembering a detail. Warm interest without insistence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと土井先生の料理本のレシピ作ったよ
lines.en: Mei-nee, Dad and I made a recipe from Doi-sensei's cookbook!
lines.style: Bright, proud rush of words. Quick tempo. The excitement of having done something with Dad. Light, unguarded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「松尾芭蕉の旅をたどってみたい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying he wants to follow in Matsuo Basho's footsteps someday.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost wistful. Slower pace. She's passing on a fragment of his longing. Tender attention in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと忠臣蔵の大石内蔵助の絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-nee, Dad and I read a picture book about Oishi Kuranosuke from the Forty-Seven Ronin!
lines.style: Excited, genuine delight. Fast, eager delivery. The pride of a child who has done something meaningful with his father. Small, real laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「杉浦日向子のエッセイは素敵」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that Sugiura Hinako's essays are really beautiful.
lines.style: Gentle appreciation in the voice. Unhurried. She's sharing something tender about his taste. Soft landing at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと小坂家の七五三のお写真見たよ
lines.en: Mei-nee, Dad and I looked at photos from the Kosaka family's Seven-Five-Three celebration!
lines.style: Bright, genuine excitement. Quick rhythm. The warmth of a small moment shared. Natural, unselfconscious joy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「田原俊彦の歌は時代を映す」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that Toshihiko Tahara's songs really capture the spirit of his era.
lines.style: Thoughtful, appreciative tone. Moderate pace. She's reflecting on something meaningful he said. Genuine interest in the idea itself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと赤松林を散歩したよ
lines.en: Mei-nee, Dad and I went for a walk through the pine forest!
lines.style: Warm, contented happiness. Slower, gentler tempo than before. The comfort of a simple moment. Small, genuine closeness in the voice.
